query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T07:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T09:00:00Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                           message LIKE "*password*", "password", "other")
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY @timestamp, user.name, event.outcome, auth_method, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 50
